description: Case seed for the Calaveras Creek grazing case, the second place: the frozen analysis geometry, the validated bundle catalog (shared with the first place) and the corpus manifest. Loaded with run-seed.ts --seed-dir data/case/calaveras-creek. This file asserts no measured result and no field visit.

case.title: Grazing and the reservoir catchment of Calaveras Creek
case.objective: Is grazing changing the rangeland of the Calaveras Creek catchment?
case.description: Reported: the catchment's rangeland is managed for grazing, and the dam of its reservoir was replaced. Not established: whether vegetation has changed, or why.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether vegetation has changed, or why.

geoSelection.label: Creek catchment (hydrological analysis extent), not a grazing lease, parcel or management boundary

geometry.sameAs: analysis-geometry.geojson in every Calaveras Creek bundle of data/bundles/ (byte-identical)

geoSelection.areaMethod: Geodesic area of the frozen polygon on the WGS84 ellipsoid, 257,455,062 m2 (area_m2_geodesic of the geometry file)
geoSelection.selectionMethod: Native 30 m delineation from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (2021 release): every cell whose D8 path reaches the outlet snapped from the USGS stream gauge 11173500 input point; rule and acceptance check in science/places/calaveras-creek.json (geometry.delineationRule)
limitations: A hydrological analysis extent, not a grazing lease, parcel or management boundary.

otherAreas.method: Planar area of the frozen polygon in EPSG:32610 (UTM 10N)
Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32610; the area_m2 of each bundle's siterra:geo_selection
